english.meaning: to watch something closely so nothing goes wrong
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: I don't understand how someone took the big bill when I was watching it so closely.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我都唔明點解我已經盯得咁實，都會俾人攞咗張大紙囖。

exampleSentences.english: So, because I thought that guy was really shady, I kept a close eye on the money.
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉於是乎，因為我覺得嗰條友真係好唔妥吖，所以呢我就即係盯住啲錢，盯得好實喇。
